sinopsis.es: Andrés se gana la vida recorriendo carreteras en un Renault 4 lleno de objetos. Viaja con su padre, que se aferra a los recuerdos de la familia y a sus antiguas narraciones de ciclismo.
sinopsis.en: Andrés lives on the road, selling knick-knacks out of his old Renault 4. Meanwhile he can barely stand his elderly, senile father, who lives in the past of old cycling radio commentaries and family memories.
